entities.summary: Chungju Mae clan is one of the Korean clans. Their Bon-gwan is in Chungju, North Chungcheong Province. According to the research held in 2000, the number of the Chungju Mae clan was 210. Their founder was Mae Gun-seo. He was from Jinan, Shandong, China. He was naturalized and settled in Chungju after he immigrated to Korea. Also, Haeju Mae clan and Chungju Mae clan have the same origin, but the population was only one family with four people.
